name: updateSubcategoryAdvanced
description: Changes a subcategory's name or icon, using its category's id and its own.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in search results.

subcategoryId.description: The subcategory's id, as shown in the category's search results.

newTitle.description: The subcategory's new name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newIcon.description: Its new picture, as a list holding one image; it replaces a library icon. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newIconName.description: Its new icon from the icon library; it replaces a picture. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when the subcategory is changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, such as no subcategory having that id or nothing to change.

result.description: The subcategory, as it is now.

iconUrl.description: Its picture, if it has one.

iconClassName.description: Its icon from the icon library, if it has one.
